```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
source(here::here("R/legislature/utils.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/ui_helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/maps.R"))

ga <- resolve_ga(params$ga)
```

```{r}
items_to_df <- function(list){
  map(list, as.data.frame) |>
    bind_rows()
}
```

```{r}
# Read legislator data
legislator <- read_json(file.path(ga_paths(ga)$people_json, paste0(params$people_id, ".json"))) |>
  pluck("person")

# Read related data
bills <- read_csv(ga_csv("bills", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
sponsors <- read_csv(ga_csv("sponsors", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
votes <- read_csv(ga_csv("votes", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
rollcalls <- read_csv(ga_csv("rollcalls", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Full people table (with people_id) — used for succession detection + successor links
people_full <- read_csv(ga_csv("people", ga), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(first_name), first_name != "")

# Mid-session replacement detection (shared helper in utils.R)
turnover <- classify_district_turnover(people_full, votes, rollcalls)
this_turnover <- turnover |> filter(people_id == params$people_id)
is_former <- nrow(this_turnover) == 1 && isTRUE(this_turnover$is_former[1])

successor <- NULL
if (is_former && !is.na(this_turnover$counterpart_id[1])) {
  succ_id <- this_turnover$counterpart_id[1]
  succ <- people_full |> filter(people_id == succ_id)
  if (nrow(succ) == 1) {
    successor <- list(
      name     = succ$name,
      party    = succ$party,
      filename = get_legislator_filename(succ_id, people_full)
    )
  }
}

# Now enrich votes with roll-call + bill context for the tabs below
votes <- left_join(votes, rollcalls, by = join_by(roll_call_id)) |>
  left_join(bills |> select(bill_id, bill_number, title), by = join_by(bill_id))

# Filter to this legislator's activity
leg_sponsored_bills <- sponsors |>
  mutate(sponsor_num = n(), .by = bill_id) |>
  filter(people_id == params$people_id) |>
  left_join(bills, by = "bill_id") |>
  arrange(desc(status_date))

leg_votes <- votes |>
  filter(
    people_id == params$people_id,
    !str_detect(description, "Report$")
  )

# Load processed vote data for party alignment analysis
legislator_stats <- read_rds(file.path(ga_paths(ga)$votes, "legislator_stats.rds"))
vote_records <- read_rds(file.path(ga_paths(ga)$votes, "records.rds"))

# Load legislator similarity data (graceful degradation if not yet generated)
similarity_path <- file.path(ga_paths(ga)$votes, "similarity_top_n.rds")
leg_similarity <- if (file.exists(similarity_path)) {
  read_rds(similarity_path) |> filter(people_id_a == params$people_id)
} else {
  NULL
}

leg_stats <- legislator_stats |> filter(people_id == params$people_id)
leg_vote_records <- vote_records |> filter(people_id == params$people_id)

# Legislator names by district for the district map
people <- read_csv(ga_csv("people", ga), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(party_id != 0) |>
  mutate(district_num = parse_district_number(district)) |>
  select(name, party, district, district_num, role)
```

```{r}
# --- Values for the profile header + stat cards ---
role_label <- if (legislator$role == "Sen") "Senator" else "Representative"

succession_notice <- if (is_former && !is.null(successor)) {
  sprintf("No longer serving — succeeded by <a href='%s.html'>%s (%s)</a> in %s this session.",
          successor$filename, successor$name, successor$party, legislator$district)
} else {
  NULL
}

# External-link buttons (rendered inside the profile header)
leg_email   <- legislator$bio$social$email
leg_website <- legislator$bio$links$official$website
btns <- list()
if (!is.null(leg_website) && nchar(leg_website) > 0)
  btns <- c(btns, list(a(href = leg_website, target = "_blank", "Iowa Legislature ↗")))
if (!is.null(leg_email) && nchar(leg_email) > 0)
  btns <- c(btns, list(a(href = paste0("mailto:", leg_email), "Email")))
if (!is.null(legislator$ballotpedia) && nchar(legislator$ballotpedia) > 0)
  btns <- c(btns, list(a(href = sprintf("https://ballotpedia.org/%s", legislator$ballotpedia),
                         target = "_blank", "Ballotpedia ↗")))
if (!is.null(legislator$votesmart_id) && nchar(as.character(legislator$votesmart_id)) > 0)
  btns <- c(btns, list(a(href = sprintf("https://justfacts.votesmart.org/candidate/%s", legislator$votesmart_id),
                         target = "_blank", "VoteSmart ↗")))
links_div <- div(class = "ia-profile-actions", btns)

# Sponsorship + voting stat values
total_sponsored <- nrow(leg_sponsored_bills)
n_sole <- if (total_sponsored > 0) sum(leg_sponsored_bills$position == 1 & leg_sponsored_bills$sponsor_num == 1) else 0
n_co   <- if (total_sponsored > 0) sum(leg_sponsored_bills$position >= 2) else 0
n_floor_votes <- nrow(leg_votes)
has_stats <- nrow(leg_stats) == 1 && leg_stats$total_votes[1] > 0
```

div(class = "ia-stats-2col",
  ui_stat_grid(
    ui_stat_card("Bills Sponsored", total_sponsored,
                 sprintf("%d sole · %d co-sponsored", n_sole, n_co)),
    ui_stat_card("Party Alignment",
                 if (has_stats) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * leg_stats$with_party_pct) else "—",
                 if (has_stats) sprintf("%d with party · %d against",
                                        leg_stats$votes_with_party, leg_stats$votes_against_party)
                 else "No floor votes recorded"),
    ui_stat_card("Participation",
                 if (has_stats) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * leg_stats$participation_rate) else "—",
                 "Of eligible floor votes"),
    ui_stat_card("Floor Votes", n_floor_votes, "Cast this session")
  )
)

```{r}
district_num <- parse_district_number(legislator$district)
chamber <- chamber_name(legislator$role)
party_color <- if (legislator$party == "D") "#3F5B93" else "#A8433A"

# Every district in the chamber, the legislator's own highlighted and drawn on
# top; the shapes come from the shared geometry file (maps.R)
map_districts <- district_geometry(chamber, ga_district_plan(ga)) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(District) |>
  left_join(people |> filter(role == legislator$role), by = c("District" = "district_num")) |>
  mutate(
    own          = District == district_num,
    fill         = if_else(own, party_color, "#CCCCCC"),
    fill_opacity = if_else(own, 0.6, 0.2),
    stroke       = if_else(own, party_color, "#000000"),
    weight       = if_else(own, 3, 1),
    label        = case_when(
      own          ~ paste(legislator$name, "-", legislator$district),
      !is.na(name) ~ paste0(name, " (", party, "-", district, ")"),
      .default     = paste("District", District)
    ),
    front        = own
  ) |>
  select(District, fill, fill_opacity, stroke, weight, label, front)

bbox <- st_bbox(district_geometry(chamber, ga_district_plan(ga)) |> filter(District == district_num))

district_map(map_districts, chamber, ga, bounds = bbox, height = 340) |>
  addTiles()
```

## Sponsored bills

```{r}
if(nrow(leg_sponsored_bills) > 0) {
  leg_sponsored_bills |>
    mutate(bill_link = format_bill_link(bill_number, bill_dir_href(ga, up = 1))) |>
    select(bill_link, title, status_desc, status_date, position, sponsor_num) |>
    mutate(
      Sponsor_Role = case_when(
        position == 1 & sponsor_num == 1 ~ "Sole Sponsor",
        position == 1 ~ "Primary Sponsor",
        position >= 2 ~ "Co-Sponsor"
      )
    ) |>
    select(-position) |>
    relocate(sponsor_num, .after = Sponsor_Role) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      bill_link = "Bill",
      title = "Title",
      status_desc = "Status",
      status_date = "Status Date",
      Sponsor_Role = "Role",
      sponsor_num = "# of Sponsors"
    ) |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = bill_link) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(whitespace = "nowrap"),
      locations = list(
        cells_body(columns = c(bill_link, status_date)),
        cells_column_labels(columns = status_date)
      )
    ) |>
    gt_theme_ia() |>
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(12)
    )
} else {
  cat("No sponsored bills found.\n")
}
```

## Vote analysis

### Votes by Classification

```{r}
if(nrow(leg_vote_records) > 0) {
  outcome_breakdown <- leg_vote_records |>
    filter(vote_text %in% c("Yea", "Nay")) |>
    group_by(vote_outcome) |>
    summarize(
      count = n(),
      with_party = sum(vote_with_party == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      against_party = sum(vote_with_party == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(pct_of_total = count / sum(count) * 100) |>
    arrange(desc(count))

  gt(outcome_breakdown) |>
    cols_label(
      vote_outcome = "Vote Type",
      count = "Total",
      with_party = "With Party",
      against_party = "Against Party",
      pct_of_total = "% of Votes"
    ) |>
    fmt_number(columns = pct_of_total, decimals = 1) |>
    gt_theme_ia()
} else {
  cat("Insufficient voting data for analysis.\n")
}
```

### Votes Against Party

```{r}
if(nrow(leg_vote_records) > 0) {
  against_party <- leg_vote_records |>
    filter(vote_with_party == FALSE) |>
    left_join(bills |> select(bill_id, title), by = "bill_id") |>
    mutate(
      bill_link = format_bill_link(bill_number, bill_dir_href(ga, up = 1)),
      vote_desc = simplify_vote_desc(vote_desc)
    ) |>
    select(bill_link, title, vote_date, vote_desc, vote_text, party_position, vote_outcome) |>
    arrange(desc(vote_date))

  if(nrow(against_party) > 0) {
    gt(against_party) |>
      cols_label(
        bill_link = "Bill",
        title = "Title",
        vote_date = "Date",
        vote_desc = "Description",
        vote_text = "Vote",
        party_position = "Party Position",
        vote_outcome = "Classification"
      ) |>
      fmt_markdown(columns = bill_link) |>
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(whitespace = "nowrap"),
        locations = list(
          cells_body(columns = c(bill_link, vote_date)),
          cells_column_labels(columns = vote_date)
        )
      ) |>
      gt_theme_ia()
  } else {
    cat("This legislator has not voted against their party.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient voting data for analysis.\n")
}
```

## Similar legislators

```{r}
make_leg_link <- function(filename, name) {
  sprintf("<a href='../%s.html'>%s</a>", filename, name)
}

make_sim_table <- function(df) {
  gt(df) |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = Legislator) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(whitespace = "nowrap"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = Legislator)
    ) |>
    gt_theme_ia() |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12), data_row.padding = px(4))
}

prep_sim_df <- function(data, type) {
  data |>
    filter(rank_type == type) |>
    arrange(rank) |>
    mutate(
      Legislator     = make_leg_link(filename_b, name_b),
      Party          = party_b,
      District       = district_b,
      Similarity     = sprintf("%.1f%%", similarity * 100),
      `Shared Votes` = n_shared
    ) |>
    select(Legislator, Party, District, Similarity, `Shared Votes`)
}

similarity_available <- !is.null(leg_similarity) && nrow(leg_similarity) > 0
```
